data.source:
- id: paying-customers
  statement: Bring in paying customers through my experiments.
  per: experiment
  window:
    after: live
    for: P7D
    grace: P1D
  success:
    label: New paying customers traced to the experiment
    settles: on_crossing
    target:
      at_least: 1
    passed: Brought a customer
    failed: Brought no customer
  milestones:
    - id: chosen
      label: Idea chosen
      by: person
    - id: prepared
      label: Package prepared
      by: auto
    - id: live
      label: Taken live
      by: person
    - id: measured
      label: Measured
      by: auto
    - id: concluded
      label: Lesson kept
      by: person
  notify:
    passed: now
    failed: now
    overdue: now
    through: tell-owner
    summary:
      cron: 0 9 * * 5
      time_zone: America/Los_Angeles
      through: weekly-note

goals.statement: Bring in paying customers through my experiments.

success.label: New paying customers traced to the experiment
